title: Development and Validation of Machine Learning-based Model for the Prediction of Malignancy in Multiple Pulmonary Nodules: Analysis from Multicentric Cohorts.
summary: XGBoost estimated malignancy probability for multiple pulmonary nodules and was compared with existing scores, clinicians, and CADx in multicentre cohorts.
ai_technology: Boosted ensemble uses clinicoradiologic variables from 1,739 nodules/520 development patients.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: External AUC 0.890 across 583 nodules and prospective comparison AUC 0.871 across 200 nodules exceeded comparator models/clinicians.
evidence.unknown: Transnational external and prospective multicentre comparisons support diagnostic validation; not evidence of improved patient outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: Boosted ensemble uses clinicoradiologic variables from 1,739 nodules/520 development patients.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
